*7 Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning. (1 John 2:7 KJV)*

John was saying that we as Christians are still supposed to live a holy life, and abide by the Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:3-17), but for a different reason. Instead of our actions of Holiness being because of the Law given under the Old Covenant, we are to live holy because of our love for God (1 Peter 1:15). As Jesus boiled the whole Law down into just two rules, love God with all your heart, and love your neighbor as yourself (Matthew 22:37-40). If you do those two things, you will fulfill the entire law given through Moses. Jesus said that if we loved Him, we would do as He said to do (John 14:15).

The basic difference between the Law and Grace is that our actions were what were judged under the law, and under Grace it is the condition of our heart. It is God’s kind of love that causes the Christian to want to live holy, not the fear of the Law. We do not live holy to please God, as He is already pleased with us because of Jesus, but we live holy to keep Satan from having access to us, and coming at us with sickness and evil of all kinds (John 10:10). God does not love us because of what we do but because of what Jesus did for us, and our faith in Him. Thank you Jesus!
